rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Bans selling, licensing or providing to a landlord an algorithmic device that uses nonpublic competitor data to recommend rents or occupancy levels, and bans landlords from using such devices to set rents or occupancy. Tenants may sue for injunctive relief, damages or civil penalties and recover attorney's fees.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each month and each property is a separate violation
rules.penalty: Tenant civil action: injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, plus costs and reasonable attorney's fees
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 11, §§98.1101-98.1104 (O-2025-107)
rules.status_basis: Proposed ordinance with blank ordinance number and final passage date; takes effect the thirtieth day after final passage.

exempt_if.name: affordable_housing_program_software
exempt_if.text: Does not include software used to establish rental rates or income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines

coverage.summary: Applies to landlords of residential rental property in the City of San Diego and to persons who sell or license algorithmic devices to them.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Excludes software that publishes reports from public information or aggregated nonpublic data over 90 days old without recommending rents, and software used for affordable housing program rents or income limits.

rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
